teaser_copy.seo_title: Pie Claesz Modern Vibes: Generative Still Life with Contemporary Restraint
teaser_copy.seo_description: A modern take on Pieter Claesz inspired still life: cleaner palette, crisp edges, and disciplined light, executed with a generative pipeline and minimal post polish.

tile_text: Contemporary still life in the spirit of Pieter Claesz

page_copy.pattern: Modern Claesz interpretation favors restraint: simplified tones, calm balance, and crisp light on familiar objects.
page_copy.action: A generative first pass set composition and palette, then targeted in painting refined edge quality, micro highlights, and surface realism.
page_copy.measured: Produces clean, contemporary still lifes that read well at thumbnail and hold detail for print, social, and provenance linked digital editions.
